Title: Full Body Burn – Beginner Fitness
Description:
Day 1 – Upper Body
- Push-Ups: 3 sets x 10 reps
- Dumbbell Shoulder Press: 3 x 12
- Bent Over Rows: 3 x 12
- Plank: 3 x 30 sec

Day 2 – Lower Body
- Bodyweight Squats: 4 x 15
- Glute Bridges: 3 x 20
- Walking Lunges: 3 x 12 each leg
- Standing Calf Raises: 3 x 20

Day 3 – Core & Cardio
- Russian Twists: 3 x 20
- Bicycle Crunches: 3 x 15
- Burpees: 3 x 10

Title: Muscle Sculpt – Intermediate Fitness
Description:
Day 1 – Chest & Triceps
- Bench Press: 4 x 10
- Incline Dumbbell Press: 4 x 12
- Triceps Dips: 3 x 15

Day 2 – Back & Biceps
- Deadlifts: 4 x 6
- Lat Pulldowns: 4 x 12
- Dumbbell Curls: 3 x 15

Day 3 – Legs & Abs
- Squats: 4 x 8
- Romanian Deadlifts: 4 x 10
- Hanging Leg Raises: 3 x 12

Title: Fat Blast HIIT – Fitness
Description:
4 Rounds for Time:
- 30 sec Jump Squats
- 20 Push-Ups
- 40 Mountain Climbers
- 20 Kettlebell Thrusters
- 60 sec Rest between rounds

Finish with 3 sets:
- Crunches: 20 reps
- Plank Hold: 60 sec

Title: CrossFit WOD – 'Grinder'
Description:
AMRAP in 20 min:
- 5 Pull-Ups
- 10 Box Jumps (24”/20”)
- 15 One-Arm Kettlebell Swings (10kg/16kg)
- 200m Run

Cool Down:
- Foam roll + Stretch 10 min
- Deep Breathing 3 min

Title: Powerlifting Split – Strength Phase
Description:
Day 1 – Squat Focus
- Back Squat: 5 x 5 @ 80%
- Front Squat: 3 x 5
- Walking Lunges: 3 x 12 each leg

Day 2 – Bench Focus
- Bench Press: 5 x 5 @ 80%
- Incline Press: 3 x 10
- Triceps Pushdown: 3 x 15

Day 3 – Deadlift Focus
- Deadlift: 5 x 5 @ 80%
- Barbell Rows: 3 x 10
- Plank: 3 x 45 sec
